history.cause: laptop restart/suspend left the long-lived transport helper process with stale auth state; every model returned 403 for ~85s
history.fix: TransportAdapter.restart() on 401/403, wired into the runner under the SAME frozen retry budget
history.rationale: Frozen rule excludes a run on transport failure AFTER the retry budget is exhausted. These calls never received an effective retry: the transport helper returned 403 on every attempt because its process-level auth state was stale. They are infrastructure failures, not model behaviour, so the affected runs are re-executed rather than excluded. No successful call was removed and no scientific result was inspected.
